title: Den älskade
description:
This screening features English subtitles.
Some stories can’t be directed.
The legendary film director Esteban Martínez is as famous for his films as for a past marked by violence and excess. When he offers his daughter Emilia a role in his new film, supposedly to help her stalled acting career, the two are forced back together after many years without contact. But living so close to each other during the shoot doesn’t just rekindle old feelings. It also reopens wounds that never fully healed.
Acclaimed director Rodrigo Sorogoyen returns with an intense, emotionally charged family drama starring Oscar winner Javier Bardem.
Distributör: TriArt Film, www.triart.se
